summary: Ameriprise Financial filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of $300M 4.800% Senior Notes due 2031 and $450M 5.350% Senior Notes due 2036 via an underwriting agreement with BofA Securities, Citigroup and J.P. Morgan. The offering was made under an existing shelf registration (Form S-3). This is routine debt financing, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring or other transformative event. No deal terms beyond the principal amounts and coupon rates are provided, and no strategic or corporate action is involved.
